title: Complete decreasing DG filtrations with shifted character-dual product layers
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use associative unital differential graded $\mathbf Z$-algebras $A$, right DG $A$-modules, their underlying cochain complexes and homogeneous right action as in [def-sfb-dg-derived-category]. A complete dual-free filtration of a right DG module $I$ is specified by quotient presentations as follows. Give right DG modules $Q_p$, degreewise surjective DG maps $\pi_p:I\to Q_p$ for $p\in\mathbf N$, with $Q_0$ degreewise zero, and DG maps $q_p:Q_{p+1}\to Q_p$ with $q_p\pi_{p+1}=\pi_p$. For every $n\in\mathbf Z$ and tuple $x_p\in Q_p^n$ satisfying $q_p(x_{p+1})=x_p$, there is a unique $y\in I^n$ with $\pi_p(y)=x_p$ for every $p$. Give degree-zero additive right $A$-linear sections $s_p$ of $q_p$ after forgetting the differentials. Give DG modules $L_p$ and DG maps $j_p:L_p\to Q_{p+1}$ which in every degree are injective with image $\ker q_p$. For each $p$ give a set $T_p$ in the component-module universe, integers $k_{p,t}$, and additive equivalences $L_p^n\cong\prod_{t\in T_p}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf Z}(A^{-(n+k_{p,t})},\mathbf Q/\mathbf Z)$. For $x\in L_p^n$, the coordinates satisfy $(dx)_t(b)=(-1)^{n+1}x_t(d_A b)$ for $b\in A^{-(n+1+k_{p,t})}$, and $(xa)_t(b)=x_t(ab)$ for $a\in A^m$, $b\in A^{-(n+m+k_{p,t})}$; canonical degree transports are understood. Thus $L_p$ is a product of the DG shifts $A^\vee[k_{p,t}]$, with unchanged right action and shifted differential. The actual filtration is $F_p^n=\ker(\pi_p^n)$; $Q_p$ represents $I/F_p$ and $L_p$ represents $F_p/F_{p+1}$. Empty products and arbitrary integer shifts are allowed. No section is required to preserve differentials.
